reopens.reason: Downstream host-vsync integration, Activity.setContentView(int) layout installation, SurfaceView/SurfaceHolder child-surface callbacks, BitmapFactory.decodeResource with agr_bitmap pixel backing, and Canvas.drawBitmap onto the locked content Surface. agr_dex_game_start_activity still returns with the traversal scheduled and not executed. do_traversal ordering, measure, relayout, layout, root Surface identity, and the first-Surface reschedule are unchanged. The child Surface is created only on the draw-pass pre_draw hook. decodeResource now retains host agr_bitmap pixels keyed by guest Bitmap identity; inJustDecodeBounds still does not decode pixels. const-class and Array.newInstance now preserve the requested array class so check-cast of a multidimensional array succeeds. dx_interpreter.c records a bounded VDISPATCH line for invoke-virtual of start, setRunning, and cleanUp. That record does not select the callee. The vtable repair is in dx_vm.c, outside this stable module. The interpreter now reads the current DxExecutionContext for the frame, exception, and instruction budget, polls a safepoint, and dispatches monitor-enter and monitor-exit. Those edits do not change guest pthread ownership. SurfaceHolder.lockCanvas and unlockCanvasAndPost bind one guest Canvas to the existing content Surface. Canvas.drawBitmap(Bitmap,float,float,null) blits through agr_bitmap_draw into that locked backing. The host mutex is held only around the locked-flag update and uses the existing worker DxExecutionContext. It does not change Thread.start, vtable slots, surfaceCreated, or surfaceChanged. Activity.requestWindowFeature(int) forwards to the Activity-owned Window. The minimum API19 PhoneWindow.requestFeature state is _features, _localFeatures, and _contentParent. FEATURE_NO_TITLE before content sets bit 1<<1, so default features 65 become 67, and returns true. The same Activity-owned Window identity is used by the request and by setContentView. This production change does not modify Activity attach ordering, ViewRoot attach ownership, first traversal, relayout, root Surface identity, Thread.start ownership, or SurfaceHolder lock ownership. It does not redesign the Activity lifecycle. Activity.getIntent() returns the Intent already stored on the Activity _intent field. The launch Intent is attached before onCreate, and the getter returns that same guest object without allocating a replacement. This accessor does not modify Activity attach ordering, ViewRoot attach ownership, first traversal, relayout, root Surface identity, Thread.start ownership, or SurfaceHolder lock ownership.
reopens.evidence: API19 ViewRootImpl.scheduleTraversals posts CALLBACK_TRAVERSAL without calling doTraversal, and Choreographer.doCallbacks extracts due callbacks before running them. The Linux host contract keeps the closed explicit first pass at handoff.viewroot_surface_ready with draw_count 0, and setContentView(int) installs one child without consuming the scheduled traversal. Discovery 35668200026 showed the int invoke bound to the View overload. Unchanged Frozen Bubble org.jfedor.frozenbubble_8 sha256 57f4735297befc68c0a7aa6cd9e442ecd250b1b2b38104324a12b6c2d4e18569 showed requestWindowFeature unresolved on execution context 0 before the fix, while the game thread, PenguinSprite.paint, lock 6, post 6, and draw_bitmap 24 still ran. After the fix the same APK records features 65 to 67 on one Window identity that setContentView keeps. The GameThread, Surface, Canvas, and Vector path still reaches GameScreen.paint, elementAt, and PenguinSprite.paint with lock 6, post 6, and draw_bitmap 24. The same APK called FrozenBubble.onCreate pc 11 Activity.getIntent before this accessor existed, and that invoke was unresolved. After the accessor, that invoke returns the Activity _intent object, which is the launch Intent, and the paint path still reaches PenguinSprite.paint with lock 6, post 6, and draw_bitmap 24.
